Each cutout week is paired with the report 2700 row dated the Tuesday after the cutout's Friday, which covers the week ending the Sunday between them ("from 2pm Previous Monday to 10am Current Monday"). An arithmetic difference between two reported series, not a statement of any packer's cost or margin.
